title: Planning takes a bug's repro questions from the pool rows its goal names, so a repro that passes means the pool rows pass
goal: a bug or story whose goal names benchmark pool rows (a kind such as sc_absent, or row ids) has a repro or check that reads those rows' own question text from the pool, and backlog.py check warns of one whose repro quotes a question no pool row holds (SP-kp3boz7z: BG-xbbimxpq's repro used 'mailbox retention policies', the pool's row says 'retention policies', and the row stayed a clean good, BG-j7pe3u46)

run:
import sys, json, tempfile, subprocess, pathlib
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import bl_base
t = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()); d = t/'_backlog'; d.mkdir(); p = t/'kb'/'public'/'_retrieval'; p.mkdir(parents=True)
(p/'bench_pool.csv').write_text('id,kind,domain,phrasing,source,question,checks,expected_route\nBP-aaaaaaaa,sc_absent,exchange,original,bench_scenarios.csv#1,What are the retention policies in Exchange Online?,[],web\n')
def w(o): (d/(o['id']+'.json')).write_text(bl_base.canonical(o))
def bug(iid, q):
    w({'id':iid,'kind':'bug','title':'t','status':'draft','priority':'P3','severity':'S3','rank':0,
       'goal':'The pool rows of kind sc_absent stay routed to the web',
       'repro':{'run':['python3','-c','import sys; q = %r; sys.exit(1)' % q]},
       'checks':[{'run':['python3','-c','import sys; q = %r; sys.exit(1)' % q]}]})
bug('BG-aaaaaaa2', 'mailbox retention policies'); bug('BG-bbbbbbb2', 'retention policies')
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/backlog.py','--root',str(t),'check'],capture_output=True,text=True)
warn = lambda i: [l for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if i in l]
a, b = warn('BG-aaaaaaa2'), warn('BG-bbbbbbb2')
sys.exit(0 if r.returncode == 0 and a and not b else 1)
